question: How many customers are registered in the United States?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers WHERE country = 'United States';

question: What is the average supplier rating?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(rating), 2) FROM suppliers;

question: How many orders were cancelled?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE status = 'cancelled';

question: What is the total revenue from completed payments?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(amount), 2) FROM payments WHERE status = 'completed';

question: How many distinct customers placed an order in 2024?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) FROM orders WHERE order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND order_date < '2025-01-01';

question: Which product has the highest total revenue? Include the product name and revenue.
gold_sql: SELECT p.name, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price), 2) AS revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 1;

question: What is the average order value, counting only non-cancelled orders?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(order_total), 2) FROM (SELECT o.order_id, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS order_total FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' GROUP BY o.order_id) t;

question: Which country has the most customers?
gold_sql: SELECT country, COUNT(*) AS n FROM customers GROUP BY country ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 1;

question: How many orders were placed in March 2024?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE order_date >= '2024-03-01' AND order_date < '2024-04-01';

question: Which category generated the most revenue? Include the category name.
gold_sql: SELECT c.name, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price), 2) AS revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id JOIN categories c ON c.category_id = p.category_id GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 1;

question: What is the average rating of products in the top-level category that has the most products?
gold_sql: WITH top_cat AS (SELECT c2.category_id FROM products p JOIN categories c ON c.category_id = p.category_id JOIN categories c2 ON c2.category_id = c.parent_id GROUP BY c2.category_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1) SELECT AVG(r.rating) FROM reviews r JOIN products p ON p.product_id = r.product_id JOIN categories c ON c.category_id = p.category_id WHERE c.parent_id = (SELECT category_id FROM top_cat);

question: How many orders are still in transit (shipped but not delivered)?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE status = 'shipped';

question: Which customer has spent the most money on completed payments? Show their full name and total.
gold_sql: SELECT c.first_name || ' ' || c.last_name AS name, ROUND(SUM(p.amount), 2) AS total_spent FROM payments p JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = p.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE p.status = 'completed' GROUP BY name ORDER BY total_spent DESC LIMIT 1;

question: What is the average fulfilment time in days between order_date and shipped_at for delivered orders?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (shipped_at - order_date)) / 86400.0), 2) FROM orders WHERE status = 'delivered' AND shipped_at IS NOT NULL;

question: How many products are low on stock (less than 20 units) and still active?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products WHERE stock_qty < 20 AND is_active = TRUE;

question: Which payment method is used most often?
gold_sql: SELECT method, COUNT(*) AS n FROM payments GROUP BY method ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 1;

question: What is the total shipping cost paid to each carrier in 2024? List carrier and total, highest first.
gold_sql: SELECT carrier, ROUND(SUM(shipping_cost), 2) AS total_cost FROM shipments WHERE shipped_at >= '2024-01-01' AND shipped_at < '2025-01-01' GROUP BY carrier ORDER BY total_cost DESC;

question: How many reviews have a rating of 5?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reviews WHERE rating = 5;

question: Which product has the most reviews? Include the product name and review count.
gold_sql: SELECT p.name, COUNT(*) AS n_reviews FROM reviews r JOIN products p ON p.product_id = r.product_id GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY n_reviews DESC LIMIT 1;

question: What is the average profit margin per order item (unit_price minus cost_price, averaged over all order items)?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(oi.unit_price - p.cost_price), 2) FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id;

question: How many customers registered in 2023 never placed any order?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers c WHERE c.created_at >= '2023-01-01' AND c.created_at < '2024-01-01' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM orders o WHERE o.customer_id = c.customer_id);

question: What fraction of orders were fully delivered in under 3 days (delivered_at - order_date < 3 days)?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE delivered_at - order_date < INTERVAL '3 days')::numeric / COUNT(*), 4) FROM orders WHERE status = 'delivered';

question: Which month in 2024 had the highest revenue from completed payments?
gold_sql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', p.paid_at) AS month, ROUND(SUM(p.amount), 2) AS revenue FROM payments p WHERE p.status = 'completed' AND p.paid_at >= '2024-01-01' AND p.paid_at < '2025-01-01' GROUP BY month ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 1;

question: Show the top 3 countries by number of orders, with order counts.
gold_sql: SELECT c.country, COUNT(*) AS n_orders FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.country ORDER BY n_orders DESC LIMIT 3;

question: How many orders have more than one payment attempt?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT order_id FROM payments GROUP BY order_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1) t;
